newsitem.title: USA: Comarco wireless unit sales up vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Comarco wireless unit sales up vs year ago.

text.p: Comarco Inc on Wednesday said product orders at its wholly owned unit, Comarco Wireless Technologies Inc, rose to $8 million in the first two months of its fourth quarter, a 40 percent increase over last year's $5.7 million in the same two-month period.
In the first 11 months of fiscal 1997, which ends in January, orders were $32.7 million, versus $15.8 million one year ago.
"All in all, Comarco's current fiscal year appears to be on track, and the prospects for next year are excellent," Don Bailey, Comarco chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Comarco Wireless provides engineering products to cellular and personal communications service (PCS) carriers.
"The rapid growth of cellular and PCS markets and the proliferation of numerous digital air interfaces is driving demand for our products worldwide."
The company said a large part of its November and December orders came from new products like its CDMA air-interface products and the LT-100, which is part of its network evaluation product line.
Comarco shares were up 1/2 to 17-7/8 by mid-afternoon.
